brief:
The Israeli military is preparing for the possibility of a broad assault on settlements in the Gaza envelope region, the Ma'an news agency reported. The preparation involves defensive and operational measures as part of contingency planning for escalating security threats in the area.

The Gaza envelope encompasses Israeli communities adjacent to the Palestinian territory, an area that has faced periodic rocket fire and militant activity from armed groups operating in Gaza.
title: Israeli military prepares for potential major attack on settlement belt
